label: standalone to token detector
explanation: It fires almost only on standalone "to" tokens, especially the space-prefixed lowercase " to", with weaker firings on To/TO/no-space variants and occasional spillover to similar prepositions or subwords. Strength is greatest for the exact lowercase " to" token and lower for variants and spillover tokens; no consistent position, topic, or preceding-word pattern is visible. It is silent on most other tokens, and the subset of " to" occurrences that do not fire shows no clear context-dependent pattern in the evidence.
